boundaries.note: 2 direct in each direction (top 2 of Liga Portugal 2 up, 17th-18th of the Primeira Liga down) plus one shared two-legged tie: 16th of the Primeira Liga v 3rd of Liga Portugal 2. One club moves through that tie, so 3 up and 3 down are not independent.
2 direct (promotion-stage 1st and 2nd up; Liga Portugal 2 17th-18th down) plus one shared two-legged tie: 3rd of the Liga 3 promotion stage v 16th of Liga Portugal 2.

Fixed 4/4, no play-off. Down from Liga 3: bottom 2 of each of its two relegation series. Up from the Campeonato de Portugal: top 2 of each of the two promotion groups (the groups are filled by the top 2 of each of the four geographic series). A club crossing this boundary is then placed in the north (Série A) or south (Série B) Liga 3 series, or in the Campeonato de Portugal series covering its district association.

conflicts.topic: Liga 3 is not a single 20-club table
conflicts.detail: PT3A is stored as one league of 20 at level 3. In reality it is two geographic series of 10 (18 rounds) that then split: top 4 of each into a single 14-round promotion stage, positions 5-10 into two 6-club relegation series (10 rounds). Treating it as one table with 34 rounds and 3 relegations produces wrong fixtures and wrong promotion places (2 direct + 1 play-off, not 3 down).

conflicts.topic: Points carry differently in the two second phases
conflicts.detail: Nothing carries into the Liga 3 promotion stage (verified on the completed 2025-26 stage: 8 clubs, 14 matches each, no bonus). The relegation stage starts with bonus points 9 down to 1 based on first-stage position. A single boolean cannot express this; JSON keeps points_carry=false for the promotion path and documents the relegation bonus in stages.

conflicts.topic: Campeonato de Portugal promotion is not 'series winners go up'
conflicts.detail: Top 2 of each of the four series (8 clubs) advance to two groups of four; only the top 2 of each group (4 clubs) are promoted. Four clubs also come down from Liga 3, so the level 3-4 boundary is a fixed 4/4 with no play-off.

conflicts.topic: Levels 1-2 share a single play-off slot
conflicts.detail: 16th of the Primeira Liga v 3rd of Liga Portugal 2 is one two-legged tie that decides one promotion and one relegation. Counting it as a separate up-place and down-place double-counts the movement.

Sporting B, Benfica B and Porto B play in Liga Portugal 2 and cannot be promoted to the Primeira Liga (they can be relegated, and go down automatically if the senior side is). A naive top-2 promotion rule will promote an ineligible club.

conflicts.topic: Source disagreement on Liga Portugal 2 promotion places
conflicts.detail: The 2026-27 English Wikipedia standings mark result1=PL, result3=PL, result5=PO, which contradicts the Portuguese prose (top 2 promoted, 3rd to the play-off). The prose is used here; the wiki table looks mis-keyed.

conflicts.topic: Campeonato de Portugal relegation line changed in 2026-27
conflicts.detail: 2025-26: bottom five of each series (10th-14th) relegated directly, 20 clubs in total. 2026-27: 13th-14th direct, 11th-12th to relegation play-offs. Below the modelled floor (level 4 -> district championships), recorded as a note only. District intake is not fixed (24 in 2025-26, 20 in 2026-27).

notes: All four database rows (18/18/20/14x4) match the real 2026-27 sizes and levels; the shapes at levels 3 and 4 do not. Season is in progress (mid-November 2026), so the counts above are the regulatory rules, not final outcomes. Levels 1 and 2 are plain 18-club double round-robins (34 rounds). Level 4 -> district championships is out of scope. Cups and UEFA competitions excluded.
